sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - The charge is not lootable from players and persists upon death as long as it is placed in a special item slot.

sections.heading: Usage
sections.text: Used to open the door of the metal gate on Terminal.

sections.heading: Location
sections.text: In different locations on Terminal. A single charge is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: First spawn
sections.text: In an open crate to the right before the end of the road the gate is on.

sections.heading: Second spawn
sections.text: Inside the tent to the right before the end of the road the gate is on on a desk.

sections.heading: Third spawn
sections.text: On some barrels in the far corner to the right before the end of the road the gate is on.

sections.heading: Fourth spawn
sections.text: On a desk under a canopy in front of a container entrance further down the short road.

sections.heading: Fifth spawn
sections.text: On the crates to the right past the end of the road the gate is on.

sections.heading: Sixth spawn
sections.text: On a desk under a canopy at the end of the road the gate is on.

sections.heading: Seventh spawn
sections.text: On the corner of the trailer to the left past the end of the road the gate is on.
